description: Labelled (claim, quote) pairs for the support-check evaluation. Quotes are copied from real chunks of the synthetic sample project (public and team sources only). Labels were written before any evaluation was run and must not be changed after seeing results.

labels.yes: the quote fully supports the claim
labels.partly: the quote supports part of the claim
labels.no: the quote does not support the claim
